org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.business

Class CameraMgmt

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.extInterface.business.CameraMgmt

  • public class CameraMgmt
extends Object
    EJB Session bean for the PCS camera command interface. This EJB is the single entry point to the PCS camera interface called from executors and diagnostic user interfaces. All calls are delegated to the ExtInfFactory which will delegate to either the actual RPC client interface or a simulator.
    Author:
    smichaels
